thread.title: Dow Jones Outperforms; 5 Stocks May Outpace Apple | Investor's Business Daily

author: DAVID SAITO-CHUNG
title: Dow Jones Outperforms; 5 Stocks May Outpace Apple | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The current stock market showed hesitant action but institutional investors responded positively to positive earnings results from the likes of IBM, United Technologies ( UTX ) and other blue chips in the Dow Jones industrial average. Consumer technology stalwart Apple ( AAPL ) suffered a measly loss of 0.1%. But the iPhone and digital services firm is lagging the major indexes year to date with a loss of around 3.3% since Jan. 1.
X The Dow Jones industrials rebounded from moderate early losses to rally 0.4%. The S&P 500 edged 0.1% lower.
Apple's 50-day moving average has continued a sharp descent since early November. This means that the stock's medium-term price trend has pointed downward for months. Watch for Apple to spend a long time forming a new base that will be first stage .
Meanwhile, Waters ( WAT ), Etsy ( ETSY ), Domino's Pizza ( DPZ ), IBM ( IBM ) and Tencent Music Entertainment ( TME ) are five companies among a growing bunch of potential market leaders. They all sport characteristics typically seen by the biggest stock market winners at the start of new price runs.
Within this group, IBM is a clear turnaround situation.
As noted in this IBD tech section story , the computer and tech services giant reported Q4 earnings and revenue that edged past the consensus view. A 1% rise in full-year revenue last year marked the first top-line gain in seven years. IBM shares, up 8% to 132.93, are trying to halt a long-term downtrend. The stock is still 21% below a 52-week peak of 168.72.
Volume is running lower vs. the same time Tuesday on the NYSE and higher on the Nasdaq. Small caps underperformed a bit. The S&P SmallCap 600 dropped 0.3%.
The Dow Jones transport average slid 1.2% as airline, delivery and railroad stocks all backtracked despite another sharp drop in crude oil prices.
Oil, Transport Stocks Lag The Dow Jones West Texas Intermediate near-term futures fell 0.7% to $52.64 a barrel. While up since Jan. 1, crude remains more than 31% below an Oct. 3 peak of $76.41. Truck, automobile transport equipment and airfreight stocks dropped hard.
Meanwhile, growth investors should focus on highly rated stocks and turnarounds that are showing exceptional relative strength.
Stock Market Leaders Moving Ahead Waters, meanwhile, broke out of a submarine-length saucer base with a 220.30 proper entry . The scientific instruments firm has blasted more than 9% higher for the week and got as high as 228.82. Waters reported a 14% jump in fourth-quarter earnings to $2.87 a share, matching its best year-over-year gain in seven quarters. That spanked the consensus view by 23 cents.
Sales rose 4% to $715 million.
For Waters, the proper buy zone goes up to 231.32, or 5% past the breakout point. In a saucer base, usually you can find the correct buy point by adding 10 cents to the left-side high of the base. Yet just like the cup with handle or the double bottom , a saucer can also feature a handle , which represents the final shakeout of weak holders before a potential breakout may emerge.
When a handle forms , add 10 cents to the top of the handle to determine the right buy point .
Restaurant Stocks Still Rise Domino's, up more than 2% on Wednesday, has now jumped back above its long-term 200-day moving average. Last week, the global pizza chain retook its 50-day line, marking a character change. The stock's RS line has spiked higher in recent days, a positive development.
According to IBD Stock Checkup , Domino's gets a solid 94 Composite Rating on a scale of 1 (awful) to 99 (excellent). Earnings per share have risen 31%, 59%, 39% and 54% vs. year-ago levels in the past four quarters as the company's global investments continue to pay off. The Street sees Q4 profit increasing 39% to $2.69 a share, on top of the 31% lift in Q4 of 2017.
Tencent Is Hammering Dow Jones A Dec. 12 spinoff from digital services giant Tencent ( TCEHY ), Tencent Music is trading near a 14.85 buy point in a narrow IPO base . At this week's high of 15.50, the stock has rallied as much as 17% since Jan. 1. Tencent Music debuted on the NYSE at $13 a share.
Tencent Music has 1.65 billion shares outstanding and a market value of $24.9 billion. The Chinese consumer spending play is the latest stock to join IBD Leaderboard .
The stocks entering the Leaderboard Leaders List showed a total gain of 11.8% last year on a portfolio-weighted basis. Leaderboard treats a full position in one stock as equal to 12.5% of the entire portfolio. The S&P 500 fell 6.2% in 2018.
See full details on Tencent Music, including detailed annotations regarding an aggressive buy point on its daily and weekly charts made in real time, on the Leaderboard home page .
A Leader In The Retail Internet Space Etsy, the global online store for artists and artisans, is chipping away at Tuesday's 4% sell-off. Shares rebounded more than 1% to 54.15 in quiet turnover. The stock is forming a cup base with a 58.40 buy point for now.
Notice on the daily chart how the Brooklyn-based internet retailer is already trading above its 50-day line. Plus, both the 50-day and 200-day moving averages are rising, a positive trend.
Analysts polled by Thomson Reuters see earnings rising 40% to 21 cents a share in the fourth quarter of last year on a 43% spike in revenue to $194.9 million. The revenue estimate would mark the highest in any quarter in company history.
Etsy grew the top line 21%, 24%, 25%, 30% and 41% vs. year-ago levels in the past five quarters. Despite that impressive growth, Etsy still has a young history in terms of annual earnings, and in 2017 the return on equity was just mediocre at 8.7%. Thus, IBD Stock Checkup shows the company receiving a B SMR Rating for sales growth, margins and ROE.
However, quarterly return on equity has improved to the 13%-14% level in recent quarters.
China Telecom Stock Also Breaks Out Amid a relatively calm day for Chinese equity indexes overnight, China Telecom ( CHA ) roared 6% higher in a solid breakaway gap. The telecom titan jumped more than 7% and hit a session high of 55.76 in volume running nicely above its 50-day average.
The strong move triggered a breakout past a seven-week flat base with a 54.19 proper buy point .
The 5% buy zone runs up to 56.90.
In Other Financial Markets Investors continued to sell long-dated U.S. Treasuries, yet demand for short-term T-bills remained solid.
This has resulted in a widening in the spread between 3-month T-bills and 10-year notes. Banks that depend a lot on the spread in making money off loans are clearly benefiting.
The current spread between 3-month T-bills and the benchmark 10-year note has grown to 35 basis points vs. 24 basis points on Jan. 2. On Wednesday, the 10-year note yield edged up 2 basis points to 2.76%. That's up from 2.66% at the start of the year.
